entities.name: Trans-en-Provence case
entities.description: Alleged 8 January 1981 landing of a saucer-shaped object on a farmer's property outside Trans-en-Provence, France, said to have left physical traces on the ground.

entities.name: Renato Nicolaï
entities.description: 55-year-old farmer and sole witness, who said a saucer-shaped object landed on his property.

entities.name: Éric Maillot
entities.description: Author of a French-language skeptical explanation of the case.

entities.name: Trans-en-Provence, France
entities.description: Town in the French department of Var outside which the event took place.

entities.name: Var
entities.description: French department containing Trans-en-Provence.

entities.name: France
entities.description: Country in which the case occurred.

entities.name: Canjuers military base
entities.description: Military base in close proximity to the site.

entities.name: Groupe d'Étude des Phénomènes Aérospatiaux Non-identifiés
entities.description: French body to which the case was sent for review and which analysed the traces.

entities.name: National Gendarmerie
entities.description: French gendarmerie; the local gendarmerie interviewed the witness, photographed the scene and collected samples.

entities.name: Popular Mechanics
entities.description: Magazine that described the case as perhaps the most completely and carefully documented sighting of all time.

entities.name: saucer-shaped object seen by Renato Nicolaï on 8 January 1981
entities.description: Lead-coloured object shaped like two saucers, about 2.5 m in diameter, said to have landed and taken off almost immediately.

entities.name: Police report on the Trans-en-Provence traces
entities.description: Police report saying the traces looked like those made by a car tyre.

entities.description: Photographs of the scene and its physical traces taken by the gendarmerie.

entities.name: physical-traces
entities.description: Burn marks, compressed and heated ground, and altered plants at the site.

entities.name: landing-reported
